caption: On a development store the partner plan unlocks everything for free with no card and no trial clock, so we could not try what each paid tier holds. The store name is hidden.
Your clients pay by monthly bundle revenue: free under $500, then $29, $49, $99, $149 and $199 a month up to $30,000. Our dossier had the table ending at $10,000. The store name is hidden.

The bands go on to $599 a month up to $500,000. Passing a band triggers a usage charge up to the next plan, capped by a limit you approve in Shopify; we never reached that screen. The store name is hidden.

The assistant built our gift box: pick exactly 3 of 8 snowboards, 15% off. The notice App extension off means shoppers could not see it yet, and we only saw it in this editor. The vendor agent's photo and name are hidden.
Uninstalling deletes data the app manages, such as discounts, and sends the developer a request to delete customer data within 48 hours.
